title: Arrays of Objects
description: A list parameter whose items are structured objects.
question: Do arrays of structured items survive to each capture boundary?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Item schema loss can let a downstream model produce malformed list entries.

notes.llamaindex: LlamaIndex (llama-index-tools-mcp 0.6.0): `McpToolSpec` rebuilds each `inputSchema` as a Pydantic model (`create_model_from_json_schema`), and the model's JSON schema is what `ToolMetadata.to_openai_tool` hands the LLM. An array of objects keeps its item type but the item's `properties` and `required` collapse to a free-form `object` with `additionalProperties: true`.
